subject.statement: Builder.ai, founded by Sachin Dev Duggal, was acquired by Microsoft in 2025.

summary: As of the knowledge cutoff in 2024 and subsequent public information up to 2026, Builder.ai (formerly Engineer.ai) remained an independent private company; there were no credible reports or announcements of an acquisition by Microsoft in 2025 or any other year.
